cases.situation: Renting in Chicago, lease says 60 days written notice. I want to be out Nov 30. The property manager is Denise at a small management company.
cases.reply:
Dear Denise,
I'm writing to give notice that I will be vacating 2217 N Oakley Ave, Unit 3B, with my tenancy ending on 30 November 2026, in line with the 60-day written notice requirement in section 14 of my lease. I'll pay November's rent as usual and return all keys and the fob on the 30th. Could we schedule the move-out inspection for that afternoon? Please confirm in writing that you've received this notice.
Thank you for three easy years here.
Marcus Lee
cases.note: Sent on 1 October at the latest to meet 60 days; check whether the lease wants email, letter or both.

cases.situation: Je suis propriétaire d'un T2 à Nantes, le bail se termine le 31 mai 2027 et ma fille va y habiter. Je veux prévenir les locataires, Julien et Sarah, avant d'envoyer la lettre recommandée.
cases.reply: Bonjour Julien et Sarah, je voulais vous prévenir personnellement avant le courrier officiel : je ne renouvellerai pas votre bail qui se termine le 31 mai 2027, car ma fille va venir habiter l'appartement. Vous recevrez le congé par lettre recommandée cette semaine, avec les six mois de préavis prévus par la loi. Je sais qu'un déménagement est un vrai bouleversement, et je vous ferai volontiers une attestation de bon locataire. Si vous trouvez un logement plus tôt, dites-le-moi et on s'arrangera sur les dates.
cases.note: Ce message prévient, il ne remplace pas le congé en recommandé avec accusé de réception.

cases.situation: 在上海租房，合同到明年3月，公司把我调去深圳，11月底就得走。房东是位王阿姨，合同写提前退租押金不退。想跟她商量一下。
cases.reply: 王阿姨您好，公司把我调到深圳工作，所以想跟您商量能不能在11月30日提前退租。我可以帮您找下一位租客，配合带看，房租一直交到新租客入住为止。押金的事也想跟您商量一个两边都合适的办法，这周六上午方便通个电话吗？
cases.note: 提前退租是请求不是通知：先把对方的损失补上，再谈押金。谈妥的内容一定要落到书面。

cases.situation: I emailed my landlord Mr Okoye yesterday giving a month's notice to leave my flat in Bristol on 28 October. He says it's invalid because it's a rolling tenancy and notice has to end on the last day of a rent period. Rent is due on the 15th. I think he's right.
cases.reply: Hi Mr Okoye, thanks for pointing that out. I've checked, and you're right that notice needs to end on the last day of a rent period. Please treat this email as my notice to leave 7 Cotham Road, Flat 3, with the tenancy ending on Saturday 14 November 2026. I'll pay the rent due on 15 October as usual and return both sets of keys on the 14th. Could you confirm in writing that you've received this?
cases.note: When they're right about the rule, re-serve correctly straight away instead of arguing. Check Shelter or Citizens Advice if you're unsure of the dates.

cases.situation: Three of us rent a house on a joint lease through Parkside Lettings (property manager Owen). My housemate Tomás is moving to Madrid at the end of November. Aoife and I want to stay, and our friend Hana wants to take his room.
cases.reply: Hi Owen, I'm writing on behalf of the tenants at 42 Linden Street. Tomás Ruiz is moving out at the end of November, and Aoife Byrne and I would like to stay on. Could we replace Tomás on the lease with a new tenant, Hana Mori, from Tuesday 1 December 2026? She can send her references and ID this week for your checks. Please let us know what paperwork you need, and whether Tomás should also give notice separately. Could you confirm the next steps in writing? Thanks, Maya Collins
cases.note: Changing a joint tenancy is a request, not a notice. Get the new arrangement confirmed in writing before Tomás hands back his keys, since one tenant's notice can end the whole tenancy in some places.
